profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a for-profit, publicly traded software company (ticker: TEAM) founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia. Its site describes it as providing team collaboration software, with products including Jira, Confluence, Trello, Loom, and Rovo AI agents, positioned as a connected platform for planning, tracking, and delivering work across software, IT, and business teams. The company reported revenue of $5,215,304,000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, filed on Form 10-K with the SEC under CIK 0001650372.

Atlassian's tracked AI products include Confluence AI, described as a team wiki tool with smart links, automation, and Atlassian Cloud governance, and Trello AI, which adds workflow automation and AI capabilities to its project management tool, also under Atlassian Cloud governance. The company's site frames its platform as designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
